name: MonarchTooltip
title: Tooltip
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.TooltipBox with androidx.compose.material3.PlainTooltip (triggers, timing, position, fade) in Monarch colours and type
summary: A short label for a control, shown on a long press, a pointer hover or keyboard focus: MonarchTooltip is the Material 3 TooltipBox and PlainTooltip in Monarch colours and type.
whenToUse: To name an icon-only control for people who see it, for example the action of a star button. The same text must also be the control's contentDescription.
whenNotToUse: Not for information the person needs to finish a task: tooltips are hidden until a long press. Not for interactive content: use MonarchPopover. Not as the only name of a control.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTooltip(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, side: MonarchTooltipSide = MonarchTooltipSide.Above, enabled: Boolean = true, content: @Composable () -> Unit)

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the box around the control.

options.name: side
options.description: The side the label prefers; it flips when there is no room.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Nothing is shown until a long press, a hover or keyboard focus.

states.name: shown
states.description: The tooltip appears above the control and hides after a short time, or when the pointer leaves.

states.name: shown from code
states.description: scope.launch { state.show() } shows it, for example on first use.

appearance: The inverse background with the inverse text at 12, 6dp corners, 4 by 8dp padding, up to 288dp wide, 4dp from the control.
platformNotes: The web Tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus, with a side, an alignment and a delay. On Android it also opens on a long press, which is the touch equivalent; the side is TooltipAnchorPosition (Above, Below, Start, End) and the delay is the system's. Text only, as on the web: interactive content belongs in a RichTooltip or MonarchPopover. iOS has no tooltip on touch and uses the accessibility hint instead.
accessibility: The tooltip is not the control's name: give the control the same text (MonarchIconButton's label).
Shows on a long press, which is the touch equivalent of hover; and on keyboard focus.
Long text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: A long press on a control with a tooltip cannot also open a context menu; choose one.
Tooltips on controls inside a scrolling list follow the control while visible and hide when it scrolls away.
